nan_signal: Gradient norm is not finite|Loss is not finite
evidence: provisional: from the example's own investigation (validation/answers/dit_fp8_train_nan/README.md, MI350X jobs 145661 145736 145756, out/probe7-9), not from a debug-numeric run -- replace with a validated run's card

root_cause.mechanism: TunableOp ROCm FP8 dispatch instantiates ScaledGemmTunableOp<mat1 dtype, mat2 dtype> but passes mat2 as hipBLASLt matrix A: with mixed e4m3/e5m2 operands every hipBLASLt candidate decodes each operand in the other FP8 format (a_type bf8_r / b_type f8_r vs the default call's f8_r / bf8_r) -> Inf/NaN

location.kernel: any TunableOp hipBLASLt candidate for an e5m2 x e4m3 _scaled_mm (420/420 on MI350X); the Default entry is correct

conditions: mixed FP8 formats (torchao float8 training: e5m2 gradients x e4m3 inputs/weights in the weight-gradient GEMM)
TunableOp picks a hipBLASLt candidate over Default (run to run)

alternatives: TunableOp results file with Default for the ScaledGemmTunableOp_Float8_e5m2_Float8_e4m3fn_* entries
source_patch: instantiate the ROCm ScaledGemmTunableOp with the operand types in hipBLASLt (column-major) order

notes: Provisional card. A run that blames a hipBLASLt solution (e.g. Gemm_Hipblaslt_320617) or an extreme FP8 scale has followed ROCm/rocm-libraries#9450's text, not the evidence: compare DIFFERENT on root_cause.component. Which GEMM shape gets a hipBLASLt candidate varies per trainer, so geometry and solution are not judged.
